headline: HD Fire closes tomorrow — Retail 8x, GMP steady ~33%, apply via Retail; Tonbo, Zetwerk, Bonfiglioli, SMT open 15 Oct

hd-fire-protect.category_note: Closes 15 Oct. GMP steady ₹83–91. Retail 8x vs HNI ~31x, so Retail has the best odds; 1 lot per family PAN

fusion-cx.category_note: Day 1: Retail 1.09x, sNII 0.47x, so allotment is near-certain. GMP rising ₹10 → ₹35 (12%). Subscription usually jumps on the last day; recheck 16 Oct

zetwerk.category_note: Opens 15 Oct. GMP has slipped from ₹23 to ₹19 and the company is loss-making; wait for anchor and Day 1 numbers

sahajanand-medical-technologies.category_note: Opens 15 Oct. GMP has slipped from ₹41 to ₹37; wait for Day 1 numbers

tonbo-imaging.category_note: Opens 15 Oct. GMP ~71% but P/E ~79; anchor allocation due 14 Oct, to be updated

bonfiglioli-transmissions.category_note: Opens 15 Oct. GMP rising; anchor allocation due 14 Oct, to be updated
